title: "Kantsoner mellom vei og natur"
author: "Jenny Hansen"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(mapview)
library(igraph)
```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# veier
veier <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/Topography/Norway_N50/Original/N50 Kartdata FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_N50Kartdata_FGDB/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_N50Kartdata_FGDB.gdb", layer = "N50_Samferdsel_senterlinje") %>% 
  filter(typeveg == "enkelBilveg",
         vegkategori != "P") %>%  # remove private roads
  mutate(road_id = row_number()) # assign unique id (missing objectid)

# natural land cover (arealtype is skog, åpenfastmark, myr or ferskvann)
natur <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/Topography/Norway_FKB/Original/FKB-AR5 FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_FKB-AR5_FGDB.gdb", layer = "fkb_ar5_omrade") %>% 
  filter(arealtype %in% c("30", "50", "60", "81"))

# Canopy Height Model classification was done in Google Earth Engine:
# https://code.earthengine.google.com/bae90ed14775ac4adac711981634e6e4
chm_bin <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/akershus_chm_binary_10m.tif")

# Pollinator prediction raster (from Markus)
poll <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/polliland_akershus.tif")
```

Find road segments that overlap natural land cover types

```{r echo=FALSE}

# switch to GEOS engine for single-sided buffers
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# create left & right buffers (20 m)
veier_left  <- st_buffer(veier,  dist = 20,  singleSide = TRUE)
veier_right <- st_buffer(veier,  dist = -20, singleSide = TRUE)

# combine
veier_left$side  <- "left"
veier_right$side <- "right"

veier_buf <- rbind(veier_left, veier_right)

# intersect with natural areas
vei_nat_part <- st_intersection(veier_buf, natur)

# calculate area of overlap
vei_nat_area <- vei_nat_part %>%
  mutate(area_nat = st_area(.)) %>%
  group_by(road_id, side) %>%
  summarise(area_nat = sum(area_nat), .groups = "drop")

# total buffer area
vei_total_area <- veier_buf %>%
  mutate(area_total = st_area(.)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# proportion of road along nature
vei_prop <- vei_total_area %>%
  left_join(vei_nat_area %>% st_drop_geometry(), by = c("road_id", "side")) %>%
  mutate(area_nat = ifelse(is.na(area_nat), 0, area_nat),
         prop_nat = as.numeric(area_nat) / as.numeric(area_total))

# filter for segments with at least 75% natural
veier_sel <- veier_buf %>%
  left_join(vei_prop, by = c("road_id", "side")) %>%
  filter(prop_nat >= 0.75)

```

Find areas that overlap CHM raster with '1' values- less than 2 m vegetation

```{r echo=FALSE}

veier_natur_vect <- vect(veier_sel)

# get proportion of cells with <= 2 m vegetation
veier_natur_vect$veg_low_prop <- extract(chm_bin, veier_natur_vect, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)[,2]

# filter for those that are at least 75% low vegetation
veier_filter <- veier_natur_vect %>% st_as_sf() %>% filter(veg_low_prop > 0.75)

```

Identify areas with high pollinator potential

```{r echo=FALSE}

veier_filter_vect <- vect(veier_filter)

# extract mean pollinator
res_poll <- extract(poll, veier_filter_vect, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
veier_filter_vect$mean_poll <- res_poll[,2]

# convert to sf
veier_sel_sf <- st_as_sf(veier_filter_vect)

mapview(veier_sel_sf, zcol = "mean_poll")

range(veier_sel_sf$mean_poll, na.rm = TRUE) # 1.214054 13.129421
```

Find suitable areas

```{r echo=FALSE}

# define some rubric of mean poll value >= X 
hist(veier_sel_sf$mean_poll)
summary(veier_sel_sf$mean_poll) # median 4.65, mean 5

# use mean values
veier_suitable <- veier_sel_sf %>% 
  filter(mean_poll >= 5) # n = 1703

# identify intersecting polygons
nb <- st_intersects(veier_suitable)

# convert to graph
g <- graph_from_adj_list(nb)

# find connected components
groups <- components(g)$membership

# dissolve using a weighted mean for value columns
veier_dissolved <- veier_suitable %>% 
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>% 
  mutate(group_id = groups) %>% 
  group_by(group_id) %>% 
  summarise(mean_poll = weighted.mean(mean_poll, area, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))

```

Filter for areas 1000 sq. m or larger

```{r echo=FALSE}

veier_final <- veier_dissolved %>% 
  filter(area >= 1000) # n = 337
mapview(veier_final, zcol = "mean_poll")

```

Export data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# write to scratch temporarily and copy to P drive
out_gpkg <- "/data/scratch/tmp_jenny/gpkg/kantsoner_vei_natur_v2.gpkg"
st_write(veier_final, out_gpkg, layer = "kantsoner_vei_natur_v2")

file.copy(
  from = out_gpkg,
  to = "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Kriteriekart/kantsoner_vei_natur_v2.gpkg",
  overwrite = TRUE)

```
